title: Lift coherent shifts through a fully faithful composite
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D,\mathcal A$ be triangulated categories with their integer shifts [def-weil-triangulated-category]. Let $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$, $I:\mathcal D\to\mathcal A$, $H:\mathcal C\to\mathcal A$ be functors. Assume that $I$ is fully faithful, meaning that each map on morphism sets is bijective. Give $I$ and $H$ specified coherent integer-shift isomorphisms $a_{n,Z}:I(Z[n])\xrightarrow{\sim}I(Z)[n]$ and $b_{n,X}:H(X[n])\xrightarrow{\sim}H(X)[n]$, natural in the objects and satisfying the unit and addition equations for the shifts. Let $e:I\circ F\xrightarrow{\sim}H$ be a natural isomorphism. Then $F$ admits coherent natural isomorphisms $c_{n,X}:F(X[n])\xrightarrow{\sim}F(X)[n]$, for every integer $n$, satisfying the unit and addition equations, whose components obey
$$
 I(c_{n,X})=e_{X[n]};b_{n,X};(e_X^{-1})[n];a_{n,F(X)}^{-1}.
$$
Here $u;v$ means first $u$, then $v$, and $f[n]$ is the image of a morphism under the ambient shift. The specified structures on $I$ and $H$ are retained.
